description: This file is a shell script utility for managing git subtrees, including operations like split, join, add, merge, pull, push, and rejoin for repositories and directories within a git project.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints messages unless in quiet mode.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages when debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Displays progress or debug messages during execution.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Asserts that a command succeeds, otherwise terminates.

methods.name: die_incompatible_opt
methods.description: Handles incompatible options with commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments and dispatches commands.

methods.name: cache_setup
methods.description: Prepares cache directories for subtree operations.

methods.name: cache_get
methods.description: Retrieves cached revision mappings.

methods.name: cache_miss
methods.description: Finds cache misses for revisions.

methods.name: check_parents
methods.description: Verifies parent revisions in cache.

methods.name: set_notree
methods.description: Marks a revision as not a tree.

methods.name: cache_set
methods.description: Stores a revision mapping in cache.

methods.name: rev_exists
methods.description: Checks if a revision exists in git.

methods.name: try_remove_previous
methods.description: Attempts to remove the previous revision if it exists.

methods.name: process_subtree_split_trailer
methods.description: Processes split trailer commits for subtree management.

methods.name: find_latest_squash
methods.description: Finds the most recent squash commit for a directory.

methods.name: find_existing_splits
methods.description: Finds prior splits related to a directory and revision.

methods.name: copy_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit based on an existing revision and metadata.

methods.name: add_msg
methods.description: Generates a commit message for adding a subtree.

methods.name: add_squashed_msg
methods.description: Generates a commit message for squashed subtree changes.

methods.name: rejoin_msg
methods.description: Generates a message for merging a split subtree back.

methods.name: squash_msg
methods.description: Creates a message describing a squash merge of subtree changes.

methods.name: toptree_for_commit
methods.description: Returns the top-level tree object for a commit.

methods.name: subtree_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the subtree's tree object at a commit.

methods.name: tree_changed
methods.description: Determines if a subtree has changed compared to its parent.

methods.name: new_squash_commit
methods.description: Creates a new squash commit for a subtree.

methods.name: copy_or_skip
methods.description: Copies a revision if needed, or skips if identical.

methods.name: ensure_clean
methods.description: Ensures the working directory and index are clean.

methods.name: ensure_valid_ref_format
methods.description: Verifies that a ref name is valid.

methods.name: should_ignore_subtree_split_commit
methods.description: Checks if a commit should be ignored during a split.

methods.name: process_split_commit
methods.description: Processes a commit during subtree split operation.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a commit or repository to the subtree.

methods.name: cmd_add_repository
methods.description: Fetches and adds a repository.

methods.name: cmd_add_commit
methods.description: Adds a specific commit to the subtree.

methods.name: cmd_split
methods.description: Splits out a subtree into a new branch or commit.

methods.name: cmd_merge
methods.description: Merges a revision into the subtree.

methods.name: cmd_pull
methods.description: Fetches and merges from a remote repository.

methods.name: cmd_push
methods.description: Pushes a subtree to a remote repository.
